answer_1.quote: The task of the proposed model M is to generate a persona consistent response R = M(Q, P)... We focus on two main aspects of the persona-based dialogues: response quality and persona consistency. To compare different models, we employ both automatic metrics and human evaluations.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses conditioned on persona and query

answer_2.quote: For dialogue quality, we employ perplexity (PPL.) and distinct 1/2 (Dist.1/2)... For persona consistency, we employ two metrics. The first is Consistency Score (C.Score)... The second metric is Delta Perplexity (∆P).

answer_4.quote: We recruit two teams (one for English and another for Chinese), each consists of five professional annotators... Human annotators are asked to evaluate dialogue quality from three conventional criteria: fluency (Flue.), informativeness (Info.), and relevance (Relv.)... The annotators are also instructed to label the consistency (Per.C.) between persona and response.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each response on fluency, informativeness, relevance (1‑5 scale) and label persona consistency (1 = consistent, 0 = irrelevant, -1 = contradicted).
